questions.q: What is the Cost Management + Billing blade used for?
options: Viewing and controlling what a subscription is actually spending, and on what
Creating new resource groups and subscriptions
Managing Microsoft Entra ID users and licenses
Writing and running KQL queries against a Log Analytics workspace
questions.explain: Cost Management + Billing is the portal area for cost analysis and budgets — answering what you're spending and why.

questions.q: Which dimensions can Cost analysis break spend down by?
options: Resource group, service, location, or tag
Only by virtual machine size
Only by the hour of the day
Only by Azure region, with no other option
questions.explain: Cost analysis can filter or group spend by resource group, service, location, or tag — tags being especially useful for projects spanning multiple resource groups.

questions.q: Does an Azure budget automatically stop resources from running once spend hits 100%?
options: No — a budget is an alerting mechanism, not an automatic spending cap
Yes — all resources in scope are automatically deallocated
Yes, but only for virtual machines, never for storage accounts
Budgets only work if Azure Policy is also configured
questions.explain: Crossing a budget threshold sends a notification; it does not by itself stop any resource from continuing to run and incur cost.

questions.q: What are the commonly used alert thresholds when setting up a budget?
options: 80% and 100% of the budget amount
25% and 50% of the budget amount
There is only ever one threshold allowed: 100%
Thresholds are set in dollars only, never percentages
questions.explain: Setting thresholds at 80% and 100% gives an early warning before spend fully exhausts the budgeted amount.

questions.q: How do tags from Chapter 1 help with cost analysis once a project spans more than one resource group?
options: A consistent tag lets Cost analysis show total project spend across every resource group it touches
Tags automatically convert a resource group into a budget
Tags have no effect on how Cost analysis groups spend
Tags can only be applied to storage accounts, not other resource types
questions.explain: A tag like project: website-migration lets you see that project's full cost even when its resources are spread across multiple resource groups.
